summary: cli_command supports multiple prompts with matching answers and check_all, for example answering new password prompts on a Junos root password change.
questions: How do I answer multiple prompts with cli_command?
How do I change a root password interactively on a network device?

answer_card.title: Answer multiple prompts with cli_command
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Change password to default
  ansible.netcommon.cli_command:
    command: "{{ item }}"
    prompt:
      - "New password"
      - "Retype new password"
    answer:
      - "mypassword123"
      - "mypassword123"
    check_all: True
  loop:
    - "configure"
    - "rollback"
    - "set system root-authentication plain-text-password"
    - "commit"
```
